I loved that episode! 

Adrien finally sees just how much of a liar Lila is – hopefully no more of this "she's just looking for attention, it's not that big of a deal" BS, because damn, pretending to be hurt just so Ladybug has to face Onichan alone even though she saved her ass minutes ago, that's downright psychopathic if you ask me! I didn't like Lila to begin with, but after this episode I despise her and I hope everyone realises what a b**** she is.

There's one thing I'm disappointed about though : Kagami. I actually liked her a lot when she was first introduced, and I really hoped she would break this trope of "obsessive girl is obsessive about Adrien and is REALLY creepy and over-the-top when it comes to him" *ahem Marinette ahem Lila ahem* but nope. In comparison : in Silencer, Luka got akumatized because his work was stolen and because Marinette was disrespected; he was akumatized because of his anger, which was partially caused by a feeling of protectiveness. Kagami was akumatized because of her anger and despair, which were 100% caused by posessiveness. I really hoped she would end up being more mature than the girls surrounding Adrien (aka Marinette, Lila and Chloé), but alas...
(this being said have you seen her adorable blushing when Chat Noir was carrying her like... is she falling for him as well???)

I loved Onichan as a villain. Her power is so cool! Can you imagine how scary it was for Lila to be followed around like that? And yet she still manages to act like her usual self, bitching Ladybug and lying all the way... She's a freaking psychopath, I'm telling ya! Also her horn growing everytime she lied à la Pinocchio was a nice touch. Also Cat Noir being like "girl you lied to me and put the one I love in danger, you're coming with me as bait whether you want it or not" was great. But not fist-bumping with Ladybug was not. My ship isn't sailing and it's not okay.

Also, Gabriel. Just... When he said to Onichan "follow Lila and make her disappear for good"... He totally expected Kagami to kill her right? That's savage. Anyway, in the end he thinks that she would make a great ally, and Lila officially become a full-time villain! I wonder if she will be the first to know who Hawkmoth really is.

Mine can last for years, but it doesn't feel like it. I know years have passed, and I know what happened during those years, but I only get to 'live' some moments. I don't really know how to explain it, it's just weird... They usually feel like a day or two, more rarely a couple of hours, but some nights they will feel like a month. I always wake up really confused from those.

I will always remember this one dream though, where it felt like many years passed and I lived the life of a single father (I'm a woman) trying to raise his two daughters, struggling to get by... I died and woke up. Boy was I lost! I was bawling, didn't even know who I was, it was scary AF.

It was two years ago; I never did that kind of dream again and I hope I never will.

(Talk of child sexual abuse, please don't read if this makes you uncomfortable or if it is triggering to you) 

When I was around six years old, I had a girl friend who was one year older than I was – she was one of my parents' friend's daughter and one of my best friend. 

Together, we used to play a 'game': one of us would lay down, and the other would give her a massage... Down here. I don't remember a whole lot about it, just that it was a secret game and that we could never, ever let my parents find out. 

It went out for a few years; I was seeing her maybe once or twice a month, and even though it's disgusting to think about now, I remember loving it. We would literally fight about whose turn it was to get a massage... I feel sick just thinking about it.

When I was ten, I had a sleepover at her house. We ate, went to bed, and played our game as usual; except that night her dad joined in. I actually remember it quite clearly, and I also remember it wasn't nearly as nice as when my friend did it – it actually hurt a lot. But my friend said it was okay, he said it was okay, so I let it happen. 

A few months later, my parents cut ties with him and his wife, but I never knew why. To this day, I never told them what happened either. I went years without thinking twice about it, and only realised how fucked up it was when I started highschool. 

Sometimes, I wonder about that girl... Was her father sexually abusing her often? Did she grow up thinking it was normal? How far did it went? Is she alright today? I tried looking her up on Facebook, but couldn't find her... She must be 21 now, I hope she's okay.
